description.value: Level Furnished Living is the Yaletown–Richards outpost of the Level Hotels chain, offering upscale furnished suites positioned between short-term hotel stays and longer monthly rentals. Located in Yaletown, one of Vancouver's most walkable and transit-connected neighbourhoods, it targets urban travellers who want home-like space in a boutique hotel setting. The brand emphasises spacious layouts and 'lifestyle amenities,' though the specifics of those amenities are not detailed on the public homepage.
